name: op_amp_buffer_unstable
description: Unity-gain buffer with heavy (100 nF) capacitive load. Same op-amp, same feedback — but the parasitic pole from Rout·Cload sits ~2 decades below GBW, dragging phase past -180° well before crossover. PM must come in dangerously low (< 30°) and GM must go below a healthy threshold. Loop broken at U1/IN- (sense pin) so the op-amp still drives its cap-loaded output. This scenario locks in that Layer 4b actually DETECTS the classic cap-load stability failure.

phase_margin_deg.rationale: A healthy design wants PM ≥ 45°. This fixture is intentionally BAD — expected to fail with PM well below that. If this check ever PASSES, either the ac_model math is wrong or the cap value doesn't create the parasitic pole it should.
